queries: WITH member_sums AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_amount FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT member_amount, CAST(member_amount AS REAL) / SUM(member_amount) OVER () AS share FROM member_sums), compared AS (SELECT member_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_amount FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT member_amount, 1.0 * member_amount / SUM(member_amount) OVER () AS share FROM member_totals), compared AS (SELECT member_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_amount FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT member_amount, CAST(member_amount AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(member_amount) FROM member_totals), 0) AS share FROM member_totals), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.member_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value;

assumptions.assumption: A missing link_to_member is SQL NULL.
The sum of eligible income is nonzero; otherwise shares are undefined and the query returns NULL aggregates.
